meta.title: Clinical team — Palsya
meta.description: The clinicians who write Palsya's protocols and take the consultation calls, with their registrations and the languages they consult in.

hero.title: Who writes the protocols and takes the calls
hero.lead: Every clinician here holds a current registration in an EU or UK regulator, and the number is listed so you can verify it. Consultations are with the people on this page, not with a call centre.

reis.cred: MD, Specialist in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine
reis.bio: Fifteen years in facial rehabilitation, most of it in a hospital clinic in Lisbon. Sets the clinical protocols behind every stage and reviews every algorithmic phase assignment flagged as uncertain.

vogt.bio: Researches nerve regeneration and outcome measurement. Responsible for what we claim, and for the wording of what we decline to claim.

brandt.cred: MSc Physiotherapy, Certified Facial Rehabilitation Therapist
brandt.bio: Wrote the exercise and taping protocols. Runs consultations and trains the clinicians who join the programme.

okonjo.bio: Specialises in synkinesis management and in patients arriving later than the usual window.

moreau.regulator: Conseil National de l'Ordre des Médecins
moreau.bio: Covers post-surgical and post-traumatic facial nerve injury, and eye protection decisions that need a physician.

weber.bio: Had Bell's palsy in 2019 and spent four months with a photocopied exercise sheet and no idea whether any of it was working. That is where Palsya started.

clinician.title: Are you a clinician?
clinician.body: If you treat facial paralysis and want to refer patients, you get a referral code that gives them {pct, number, percent} off and — with their separate consent — lets you read their progress reports.
